property_summary: After calling assertGovernanceApproved from an address that is both the DAO and a governed address, the reference contract allows the DAO to set DAO to a new address while configured is true (by the original conditional: DAO==address(0) || msg.sender==DAO || !configured), whereas the buggy contract reverts because configured is true regardless of caller.
change_summary: Replace the conditional guard so that setDAO only runs when configured is false, regardless of who calls it.
